title: Criteria-Governed Decision-Making in Sparse Seismic Networks: Evidence Sufficiency, Non-Confirmation Reliability, and Analyst Escalation (code, pre-registrations and results)
description: Code, pre-registered test plans, per-episode decision records and result files for the manuscript "Criteria-Governed Decision-Making in Sparse Seismic Networks: Evidence Sufficiency, Non-Confirmation Reliability, and Analyst Escalation" (S. Zhakypbekov, A. Bykov, A. Shaikemelova, T. Chinibayeva; submitted to Sensors, MDPI). Pre-specified tests at two Kazakhstan reference stations, a second Kazakhstan network, Alaska and 38 seismic networks in eight regions selected by a metadata rule, scored against catalogue association and against analyst-reviewed bulletins (ISC Reviewed Bulletin, USGS ComCat); post hoc robustness analyses, including a stress test with controlled loss of neighbour evidence. Test plans are registered on OSF: https://osf.io/y8qxz (DOI 10.17605/OSF.IO/Y8QXZ). Source repository: https://github.com/Syrym-Zhakypbekov/sparse-seismic-criteria-governed-triage
